attribution: Chixuan Li, Chengqian Zhang and Yan Ren, Growth and morphological control of metastable KDP crystals using defect-free seeds, RSC Advances 16 (2026), 10012-10021, supplementary movies S1-S3
split_semantics: Development-only; all clips stay in the same conservative study family. No independent run/specimen identity or final evaluation split is established.
clock_semantics: Container presentation timestamps are display time. Published speedup supports only an inferred relative elapsed time. Actual acquisition timestamps, growth-run start and first-hour coverage remain unknown.
pixel_semantics: Original MOV bytes preserved; frame hashes describe native decoded BGR pixels under the recorded decoder. Annotation PNGs retain those pixels without resize, crop or overlay removal.
label_scope: Review visible crystal instances and truncation/uncertainty. Co-seeded crystals present from the start are not parasitic-nucleation events. Phase-transition textures are not automatically inclusion labels. No event, negative-period, face-rate, action-response or quality truth is supplied.
